system.description: The curse that the Baali of Chorazin laid upon the Assamite warrior caste has fallen upon you, leaving you plagued with an unending hunger for the blood of other Cainites. Whenever you taste Cainite vitae, you must win a Self-Control test (difficulty eight Traits) or fall into a hunger frenzy in which you will do anything to gorge on as much blood as possible. If you follow a Road that teaches Instinct, no roll is possible — you are instantly lost to the frenzy, and the Flaw is worth four Traits instead of two. You often find yourself thinking of other Cainites, even fellow Assamites, as potential vessels rather than equals. This Flaw is mainly found among the warrior caste, and is rare among sorcerers and viziers except those who have partaken of warrior vitae or spend most of their time in warrior company.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
